# GoToFlow - AI Content Generator for Social Media

GoToFlow is an AI-powered content workflow for creating social media posts, LinkedIn carousels, Instagram carousels, captions, and reusable content ideas from prompts, articles, notes, and source materials.

## Target Audience

GoToFlow is built for brands, marketers, creators, agencies, founders, and businesses that need faster social media content production without starting every post or carousel from a blank page.

## Core Offerings

- AI content generation
- LinkedIn carousel creation
- Instagram post generation
- Instagram carousel generation
- Social media content workflows
